noticias.titular: What to watch during MLB's final weekend of the 2026 season

noticias.titular: Diamondbacks place Burnes on IL in midst of wild-card push
noticias.texto: Arizona right-hander Corbin Burnes was placed on the 15-day injured list with shoulder inflammation Friday, a day before he was to start for the Diamondbacks as they try to stay alive for the National League's final wild-card spot.

noticias.titular: Dodgers' Roberts says he trusts Ohtani to be ready for playoffs
noticias.texto: Los Angeles Dodgers manager Dave Roberts says he trusts Shohei Ohtani to manage his workload and be fully healthy for the start of the playoffs.

noticias.titular: Marlins' Perez one-hits Braves in MLB's 11th shutout of season
noticias.texto: Eury Perez dominated the playoff-bound Braves, finishing with a one-hit shutout Friday night in the Marlins' 3-0 win.

noticias.titular: White Sox's Montgomery sets single-season strikeout record
noticias.texto: White Sox infielder Colson Montgomery set the record for most strikeouts in a season with his 224th on Friday.

noticias.titular: De La Cruz becomes fourth Reds player to join 30-30 club
noticias.texto: Elly De La Cruz joined Eric Davis, Barry Larkin and Brandon Phillips as the only players in Reds history to achieve a 30-30 season.
